title: Bitty Box Link Policy (v1)
description: Authoritative JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) for a Bitty Box link access policy in the v1 launch scope. A policy is an ordered set of gating rules evaluated before a gated payload is delivered. v1 supports: password, TOTP, passkey/WebAuthn, time window, session TTL, max opens / one-time, and out-of-band Telegram approval. Geo restrictions, IP allow/deny lists, and mTLS are explicitly OUT of scope (v2) and MUST NOT appear here. Per locked SCOPE.md rule 4, audit logging is always enabled and cannot be disabled.

version.description: Policy schema version. Pinned to 1.0 for the v1 launch.

evaluation.description: How multiple rules combine. 'all' = every rule must pass (AND); 'any' = at least one rule must pass (OR).

rules.description: Ordered list of gating rules. At least one is required for a gated link.

delivery.description: How the payload is served after all rules pass. Gated payloads always stay server-side; the public URL alone never yields protected content (SCOPE.md rule 3).

audit.description: Audit logging configuration. Always enabled in v1 (SCOPE.md rule 4).

rule.description: Discriminated union of all v1 gating rule types.

required.description: Whether the viewer must supply a password before delivery.

min_length.description: Minimum accepted password length (enforced at enrollment / link creation).

hint.description: Optional non-secret hint shown on the gate page.

require_enrolled.description: True means the creator must have enrolled a TOTP secret before the link can be used.

issuer.description: Issuer label encoded into the otpauth URI.

label.description: Account label encoded into the otpauth URI (e.g. creator email).

require_enrolled.description: True means the creator must have registered at least one passkey before the link can be used.

user_verification.description: WebAuthn user verification requirement for the assertion.

not_before.description: Link is inert before this ISO-8601 datetime (UTC).

expires_at.description: Link auto-revokes at this ISO-8601 datetime (UTC).

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Session expires after this many seconds of inactivity.

max_lifetime_seconds.description: Hard cap on session lifetime regardless of activity.

max.description: Maximum number of successful opens allowed. Must be >= 1.

one_time.description: If true, the link burns after the first successful open (max is forced to 1).

required.description: If true, every open requires explicit owner approval via Telegram (HITL). If false, the owner is only notified.

chat_id.description: Telegram chat id to receive the approval request / notification. Resolved from the owner account when omitted.

method.description: How the payload is released after auth. 'signed_grant' issues a short-lived post-auth grant token (default, most secure). 'redirect' sends the viewer to redirect_url. 'inline' streams the stored payload directly.

grant_ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime of the post-auth delivery grant token (signed_grant only).

enabled.description: Audit logging is always on in v1. Locked by SCOPE.md rule 4.

log_reason.description: Log the allow/deny reason for every policy evaluation.
